Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us! South Africa have clinched the series with this win and now go into the Wanderers looking to whitewash Sri Lanka. The Islanders on the other hand, will be playing for their dignity and one will hope they'll learn from their mistakes and put their best foot forward. The last and final match will take place in Johannesburg, at the Wanderers where we'll have another good contest, hopefully. It starts on 12th January at 1000 local time, 1330 IST. Join us for it. Till then, cheers!

Man of the Match, KAGISO RABADA says it's all the hard work paying off. Mentions that he was investing in tactics and gameplans which has eventually paid off. He feels that he was struggling in the first innings but then found his rhythm and used the moment to pick as many wickets as he did. While he is humbled, he says there are other quality bowlers in the side who could have done just the same, today was just his day so is happy to contribute.

South African skipper, FAF DU PLESSIS says before this match, they wanted to dominate Sri Lanka and they have done it every single day. Adds that the Lankans weren't up for it in this game. States that the conditions are different in different places and they just have to apply themselves wherever they play. Mentions that Day 3 and 4 were tricky, the ball was stopping a bit but they did well and picked wickets as and when they came. Lets everybody know that what he enjoys most about Test cricket is that the other team is allowed to play well, and they just have to stay patient and wait for their moment. Applauds Kagiso Rabada for the way he came out and ripped through the Sri Lankan batsmen. On resting players, he is clearly adamant that he wants to put his best team out at the Wanderers and not shuffle anything around.

Sri Lankan skipper, ANGELO MATHEWS says it is disappointing especially after winning the toss. Praises Dean Elgar for his wonderful performance with the bat. Opines that his batters have let the team down giving no chance to the bowlers. Adds that you need long hours of concentration and that was the difficulty they have largely had in the first two Tests. On Kumara, he is happy with how he has done with the ball, took 6 wickets in the first innings and did really well for his age. Credits Rabada for the way he bowled in the second innings. Ends by stating that the batting department needs to do better and perform at the Wanderers.

Earlier in the match, centuries from Elgar and de Kock set South Africa up for a huge first innings' total. Then their bowlers did the magic and bowled out Sri Lanka for a paltry score of 110. Du Plessis then decided to bat again and Elgar once more stepped up, scoring a half century to set a target of 507 for the Islanders. And another superb all-round bowling performance saw the Lankan batsmen falter. If one was to point out what let them down, it would be their performance with the willow.

Mathews and Chandimal were looking good but an inspired spell from Rabada proved to be their undoing. The latter first chipped it straight to Cook while the former didn't learn from his mistake in the first innings and got out in a similar fashion. Tharanga looked to play his shots but in the end it was one too many and had to walk back. That exposed the tail. Herath gave a good fightback and remained unbeaten on 35 but nobody else supported him.

South Africa seal the deal here itself and clinch the series 2-0! It was a complete performance by the hosts. They batted well, bowled well, fielded well and got their reward. They needed 6 wickets more to win the match and they came out in style. Rabada led the bowling by picking the first 4 wickets of the morning and completed his 2nd 10-wicket hall in Tests. Maharaj and Philander did the rest by taking the next two wickets. Even though Abbott didn't pick any wickets, he kept it tight which helped the other bowlers.

OUT! PHILANDER FINISHES IT IN STYLE! Full on off, Pradeep looks to go big and swings his bat hard but ends up swinging it in the air. The ball is a straight one and plucks the off stump from its root. That's 7th wicket for Philander in the match! SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY A HUGE MARGIN OF 282 RUNS!
Length delivery angling in, Pradeep stays in the crease and defends it with the angle on the leg side.
Shortish delivery, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
Fuller on middle and off, Pradeep defends it late with soft hands. The ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards square leg for a single.
Length delivery angling across, Herath pulls it through mid on for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Pradeep prods forward and defends the ball on the pitch.
Landed outside off, Pradeep prods forward in defence but the ball spins away a touch, goes off the outside edge past second slip.
Tossed up on middle and off, reverse swept through point for a single.
Tossed up on the stumps, defended from within the crease.
FOUR! Full toss outside off, Herath slogs it through mid-wicket. Duminy in the deep initially looks to cut it out but then gives up on his chase. The ball races towards the fence.
FOUR! Fullish outside off, Pradeep goes for an expansive shot on the off side. But, the ball balloons off the outside edge and goes over the slip cordon for a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length delivery outside off, Pradeep looks to defend it with the angle but the ball holds its line and whizzes past the outside edge.
Pitched on a length outside off, Pradeep stays back and defends.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the front foot.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Herath stays tall and taps it through cover-point for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, blocked solidly.
NUWAN PRADEEP is the last man in!

OUT! MAHARAJ THE MAN! Tossed up nicely outside off,  drawing Kumara forward. He obliges and steps out, gives himself some room and looks to go big on the off side. However, he misses it completely and the ball goes into the gloves of de Kock, who takes it cleanly and removes the bails in a flash. That's clever work from the bowler and good work from the keeper. This ends the frustrating 33-run partnership! SA JUST A WICKET AWAY FROM THE MATCH AND THE SERIES WIN!
Fuller on the stumps, Herath once again kneels down and sweeps it through square leg. Duminy in the deep covers good ground and gives away only a single even after a fumble out in the deep.
Herath prods forward and blocks the delivery on the bounce.
Spinning into the pads, flicked on the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length delivery on off, angling in, Kumara clears his front leg and block it. It was the same delivery, which he had left in the first innings and got bowled.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Outside off, Kumara looks to defend with a straight bat but the ball goes off the outside edge and into the ground towards the slip cordon.
Short delivery, angling in, pulled through the leg side for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Herath lofts it over covers for a couple.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Tossed up on the stumps, Herath sweeps on the leg side for a single.

Around middle and leg, spins in a touch, Herath looks to defend by prodding forward but the ball goes off the pads into the hands of Cook at short leg. The fielding side appeals but it's turned down by the umpire. They don't go for the review. Had they taken it, the result would have been different as the Snicko shows that there was slight glove involved and Herath was out.
Comes around the wicket, bowls an arm ball, Herath looks to defend it from within the crease but the ball goes straight on with the arm and beats him.
FOUR! Tossed up on the stumps, swept aerially through front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Spinning in from outside off, Herath defends it with the spin on the leg side.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off, Herath reverse sweeps it through third man for a boundary.
Short delivery, mistimes his pull at mid-wicket. Earns a single for that!

Full outside off, pushed through covers. The Lankan batsmen run through for the second and could be in trouble but Bavuma's throw from the deep doesn't hit the target and there's no SA fielder closer to the stumps, to receive the throw. Two runs taken!
Full and angling in, Herath digs it out well.
Full outside off, carved to point.
Outside off, left alone.
JUST SHORT! Back of a length delivery outside off, Herath stands tall and punches it uppishly. The ball falls just short of Bavuma at point.
VERNON PHILANDER comes into the attack now!
Straighter one outside off, Kumara looks to play for the spin and gets beaten.
Another inside edge towards the right of the keeper.
Kumara once again looks to go big but the ball catches the inside edge and goes towards the leg side.
FOUR! Kumara is playing his shots! Uses his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over widish mid on for a boundary.
FOUR! Tossed up delivery outside off, Kumara clears his front leg and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Length delivery outside off, Kumara edges it into the ground towards backward point for a single.
Length delivery, defended from within the crease.
Banged in short! Kumara ducks under it.

Back of a length delivery, angling across, Herath looks to pull it but the ball rises on him and balloons off the top edge. The ball falls safely just away from Philander at short widish mid on. A single is taken!
FOUR! That's come out of nowhere! Length delivery outside off, Herath stays in his crease and smashes it over mid on for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, punched through covers for a brace.
Kumara prods forward and blocks the ball on the bounce.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up on the stumps, Herath once again looks to sweep and connects it this time. The ball goes through the mid-wicket region and the batsmen run through for a single,
Herath stays in his crease and defends the incoming delivery late.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up outside off, Herath looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. Maharaj and co. appeal but umpire Dar is unmoved. Impact outside off maybe!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
LAHIRU KUMARA is the next man.

OUT! 10-WICKET HALL FOR RABADA! He is on fire! Back of a length delivery outside off, angling closer to the body of the batsman. Lakmal looks to fend it by getting high on his toes. The ball holds his line and brushes the outside edge of Lakmal's bat and goes behind, where de Kock grabs it on a good height. That's end of Lakmal's short stint! SL collapsing like a pack of cards! SA NEED 2 WICKETS MORE TO WIN!
Angling into the pads, Lakmal looks to tuck it but miscues it. The ball is in air for sometime but the ball lands safely, just before Cook from short leg can reach it.
Outside off, left alone.
Full outside off, SL drives it though the gap in covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Full and angling in, Lakmal clips it uppishly off his boots, over Cook at short leg, who ducks under it to get out of harm's way. The ball races towards the square leg fence.
Straighter one outside off, Herath looks to play for the spin and gets beaten as the ball straightens a bit.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up outside off, Herath takes a big step ahead and blocks it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Spinning in from outside off, Herath looks to cut it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Served outside off, spinning in, Herath moves across and pads it away from his back pad. The fielding side appeals but is turned down. De Kock is very much animated and tells his skipper to take the review. But, the skipper doesn't take it and it's a good decision as the ball was missing the stumps by a margin.
KESHAV MAHARAJ is into the attack!
Length delivery angling in, Lakmal looks to defends it from within the crease but the ball nips back in and hits him on the pad.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Lakmal gets on his toes and blocks it.
Wide outside off, Lakmal looks to slash it but fails.
Fullish outside off, the ball keeps a touch low. Lakmal looks to drive it but misses.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot.
Short delivery again to Herath, once more he pulls and gets a single for it.
Fired in fuller on the stumps, Lakmal does well to dig it out.
FOUR! Superb shot! Full and angling in, Lakmal leans into the shot and drives it through mid on for a boundary.

On a length and angling in, Lakmal looks to play it across the line but is late in his shot and the ball beats the bat and hits him high on the pads. Abbott appeals looking for his first wicket of the match but the umpire is unmoved. Abbott isn't too disappointed with the decision as he knows it's a touch high and goes back to his bowling mark.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shortish delivery, pulled aerially through the right of Cook at short leg for a single.
Outside off, driven to covers.
SURANGA LAKMAL Is the new man in!
5th Test 5-fer for Kagiso Rabada.

OUT! 5-FER FOR RABADA! SKIPPER DEPARTS! Length delivery outside off, Mathews looks to play it on the up but away from his body. Lack of foot movement there which gets the SL skipper in trouble as the ball moves away touch and also rises a little extra. It goes off the outside edge in the gloves of de Kock. It's similar to his first innings' dismissal. Double blow from Rabada in an over!
Length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot.
Shortish delivery, angling in, pulled through square leg for a single.
On the pads, flicked on the leg side.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched through covers. Herath wants a single and takes off but is sent back by his skipper.
RANGANA HERATH walks in, replacing Tharanga.

OUT! RABADA STRIKES AGAIN! Pitched on a good length around off, angling across, Tharanga looks to cut. However, the length isn't short enough to cut and pays the price. The ball catches the bottom edge and goes in the gloves of de Kock, who doesn't make any mistakes. One shot too many for Tharanga got the better of him in the end! SA NEED 4 WICKETS TO WIN!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length delivery outside off, defended from within the crease.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Full on the pads, clipped beautifully through mid-wicket for a boundary. Runs are flowing here for SL!
FOUR! Straight down the ground! Full outside off, driven straight back for a boundary. Well-balanced shot!

EDGED BUT FELL SHORT! Slightly fuller outside off, Mathews looks to defend by prodding forward but edges it but it goes one bounce into the hands of second slip. Playing with soft hands saved him there!
Fuller length outside off, pushed to silly mid off.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, defended off the back foot.
Full outside off, Tharanga gets down on one knee and looks to go for another expansive drive but miscues it and the ball goes off the inside half of the bat towards mid on.
FOUR! Similar shot, same result! Fullish delivery outside off, this time Upul stays in his crease and drives it on the up through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! A touch fuller outside off, Tharanga drives beautifully on the up through covers for a boundary. That's a spectacular shot and all the commentators on air are full of praise for it!
Rabada changes his angle, comes from around the wicket, angles it in from a length outside off, Tharanga looks to play it across the line but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.

FOUR! Good start to the innings by Tharanga! Angling away from the southpaw, Tharanga opens the face of his bat and guides it through the gap between the slip cordon and gully for a boundary. No ball signalled as well as Rabada overstepped his line.
UPUL THARANGA is the new man! 3 slips, a leg slip and a short leg in place for him!

OUT! RABADA WITH THE BREAKTHROUGH! Just the start SA wanted! Full and angling in, Chandimal clips it uppishly off his pads straight to Cook, who is placed just in front of square on the leg side. Great captaincy by Faf to place Cook in that position. Rabada continues his impressive spell with the ball! That's breaks the 75-run partnership! SA ARE 5 WICKETS SHY OF THE VICTORY!

FOUR! STAND AND DELIVER! Full outside off, Mathews stays tall in his crease and pushes it uppishly through mid off for a boundary. It's the safest place to play such shots as the player is placed wide.
A silly point is in place now! But, Abbott angles this in and Mathews defends it on the leg side from within the crease.

Once again Mathews feels the jerk and removes the bottom hand on connecting with the ball. Length delivery outside off, Mathews looks to defend it off the front foot but the ball rises a touch and hits him high on the bat.
Outside off, AM remains composed in defence.
Length delivery angling in from outside off, Mathews covers his stumps and defends it towards short leg. Abbott is keeping it tight and giving nothing away!
Fuller around off, angling in a touch, defended straight back.
Low full toss on off, driven to Philander at short widish mid on. Failed to get that away!
Back of a length delivery, angling in, Mathews rises on his toes and defends it with soft hands towards short mid-wicket. Takes off for a quick single and completes it.
Length delivery outside off, Mathews defends it off the outer half of his bat towards cover-point.
Banged in short, Mathews ducks and lets it sail over!
Chandimal plays it with the angle through widish mid off for a single.
Length delivery outside off, angling in, defended solidly.
On a length outside off, Mathews looks to defend it off the front foot but the ball bounces a touch extra and hits the bat on the higher part, jerking Mathews.
Angling into the pads, flicked front of square on the leg side.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mathews defends it on the surface off the back foot.
Length delivery outside off, defended with a straight bat.
Angling in, defended on the leg side.

On the fuller side of the length outside off, Mathews looks to push it but is early into the shot as the ball holds a touch after pitching. The ball goes uppishly from the left of Abbott and through mid off for a couple.
Full around off angling in, Chandimal gets behind the line of the delivery and plays it towards widish mid off.
On a length outside off, arms shouldered by DC.
Full outside off, angling in, Mathews covers his stumps and turns it to mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, Mathews wisely leaves it.

Mathews is beaten again! Full delivery outside off, Mathews looks to defend it off the front foot but is beaten in his defence once more this morning. The ball keeps a touch low too! That will create doubts in the batsman's mind.
Length delivery, angling down leg, tucked off the hips towards deep backward square leg for a single.
KAGISO RABADA to bowl from the other end.
Length delivery, angling in, defended on the off side.
BEATEN! On a length in the corridor of uncertainty, Mathews hangs his bat in defence and the ball whizzes past the outside edge. Good shape on that by Abbott!
Length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot.

FOUR! EDGY BOUNDARY! On the fuller side of the length, Mathews looks to defend it off the front foot but the ball reverses a bit, shapes away and goes off the outside edge from between point and gully to the deep backward point fence.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Length delivery outside off, Mathews shoulders his arms.
The players are out in the middle. ANGELO MATHEWS and DINESH CHANDIMAL to fight it out for Sri Lanka. KYLE ABBOTT with the ball in his hands. He will be keen to be amongst the wickets. Here we go...

Faf du Plessis must have surely told his men to wrap things up quickly. Having some good rest in the night and the ball moving about some early in the day, they'll back themselves to do just that. Let's see how this day plays out.

Hello and a warm welcome for the 4th day of this second Test between South Africa and Sri Lanka. With the hosts being in a commanding position, it's only a matter of time before this match is won and the series is sealed. Unless, of course, Angelo Mathews and Dinesh Chandimal pull off something miraculous. The entire onus will be on them and now, with just 6 wickets left, the two experienced campaigners must step up like they have never before.
... DAY 4, SESSION 1 ...

The Proteas are just 6 wickets away from their victory or one can say that if they break the current partnership, they will have one hand on the trophy. Will we see the South African bowlers clean them up ASAP? Or will there be an inspired fightback from the Islanders? To get to know about it join us tomorrow at 1400 IST. Till then, take care!

Sri Lanka once more had a day to forget as they let SA score freely and then lost 4 wickets before the end of day's play. However, one of the wickets, that of Dhananjaya de Silva could have been avoided if they had reviewed it. Now, they will rely on the two current batsmen to make their experience count and perform a miracle to chase a record total down.

They put SL in to bat just before tea and got what they wanted by sending Karunaratne packing before the break. They started the last session in the same bright fashion as they saw the back of Mendis immediately. Both of these wickets were taken by Philander. Rabada then followed his footsteps and got himself all pumped up and took the next 2 Lankan wickets.

An unbeaten 61-run stand between skipper Mathews and vice-captain Chandimal sees the last session off safely and makes sure that there will be play on day 4 also. However, it was South Africa's day. They came in to bat and set a huge target of 507 in front of the Lankans.
FOUR! Full outside off, driven through covers for a boundary. That's a fine way to end the day as the umpire takes the bails off. STUMPS ON DAY 3!
No ball! On the fuller side of the length on off, DC keeps it down on the off side. No ball signalled for overstepping.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Fullish delivery outside off, Chandimal presses forward and pushes it to covers.
Outside off, left alone!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length delivery outside off, Dinesh looks to defend it off the front foot but the ball shapes away and goes off the outside edge into the ground and towards gully.
Back of a length delivery angling in, Mathews hops and looks to play it across the line but gets beaten and is hit on the abdomen.
FOUR! Beautiful drive! Full outside off, driven straight back by Mathews. Rabada from mid on gives it a chase but the ball beats him easily.
Banged in short again, this time Mathews sees it early and ducks under it.
That's a ripper! Banged in short outside off, angles it closer to Mathews' body. The Lankan skipper does extremely well to lean back and let it sail through.
Full outside off, Mathews prods forward and blocks it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mathews gets on his toes and defends it on the leg side.
Full outside off, Chandimal leans and pushes it through covers for a couple.
On middle and off, Chandimal defends it off the front foot.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
50-run partnership between Mathews and Chandimal!
Fuller on the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a brace.
Length delivery angling in, keeps a touch low, Chandimal does well to bring the bat down in time and defend on the leg side.
Full and angling in, Chandimal looks to flick it but misses and is hit on the pads.
Length delivery, angling in, defended off the back foot.

Fullish delivery outside off, Chandimal prods forward in defence but the ball goes off the outside edge past third slip. Duminy from gully chases it down and cuts it before the fence. Three runs taken!
Outside off, left alone.
Angling into the pads, DC looks to work it on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.

Length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot straight down the ground. Abbott fails to stop it on his follow through so does Rabada who comes running in from mid on. Till the time Rabada tidies up, the batsmen run through for three runs.
Length delivery outside off, defended into the surface on toes.
KYLE ABBOTT comes into the attack!
Fuller length ball outside off, Dinesh comes forward and pushes it nicely through the covers. Two runs taken!

THERE IS NO NEED TO TAKE SUCH RISKS! This time Mathews clips it with soft hands towards square leg and sets off for a run. The fielder gets across to it in a flash and hurls in a throw at the striker's end but misses. Chandimal had to rush back in to get home.
GREAT BOWLING BY PHILANDER! Bowls it on a length on off, shapes away a touch. Mathews is squared up as he looks to work it across but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Stays back to the length delivery and defends it to the off side.
LOOSE SHOT! Bowls a shortish delivery wide outside off, Mathew slashes at it hard but gets beaten.
On a length on leg stump, Chandimal clips it towards mid-wicket and immediately calls for a run. Mathews is ball watching but finally gets going. Completes the single safely in the end.
Camps back to the shorter delivery and defends it down the pitch.

FOUR! Bowls a loopy ball on middle, Mathews sweeps it against the spin and gets it through the vacant deep backward leg region. Gets a boundary to his name. The partnership moves on to 34 off 55 balls.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted delivery outside off, Mathews prods forward in defense.
Loopy ball outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Comes down the track and defends it towards mid off.
Similar length ball angling in, defended off the back foot to the on side.
Short of a length ball on off, Chandimal is opened up in his stance but manages to play it with an angled blade towards point.
This time Chandimal gets right behind the line of the delivery and defends it.
Fullish delivery tailing back in, clipped gently to mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! WELL PLAYED! Bowls a shortish delivery outside off, Dinesh camps back and punches it nicely through the covers and the ball races to the fence.
VERNON PHILANDER comes back for a bowl. Can he strike?
Fullish delivery on off, driven down the ground to mid on.
Camps back to the shortish delivery and punches it through cover-point for a run.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
UPPISH BUT SAFE! Bowls a flighted delivery around leg stump, Mathews looks to sweep it against the spin but gets a top edge that balloons towards the vacant short fine leg region. Three runs taken!
Bowls a loopy delivery, Chandimal comes down the track and clips it towards the man at short mid-wicket. he fumbles a bit and parries it towards mid on. A run taken!
Fullish delivery on the stumps, Mathews opts to stay back and defends it towards short fine leg for a single. He should have played that on the front foot.
Fullish outside off, driven to the covers.
FOUR! He is getting his deliveries to curve back nicely. Bowls this one very fullish at 143.6 and it's tailing back in, Dinesh clips it through mid-wicket and gets a boundary to his name.
Dug in short on middle and leg, Chandimal ducks under it.
Camps back and defends this one nicely.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a length on off, Chandimal leans forward and blocks it.
FOUR! SHOT! Bowls this one shorter and wide outside off, Angelo camps back and cuts it hard through point for a superb boundary.
Shortens his length again, Mathews looks to sweep it hard but misses and his hit on the right shoulder.
Mathews drives this one with the spin to mid off.
Shortens his length and bowls it around off, spinning away. Mathews looks to sweep it but is struck on the forearm.
Tossed up outside off, Mathews drives it hard towards Faf at silly mid off. He dives athletically to his left and makes a brilliant save. Hurls a throw back to the keeper. Top stuff from the skipper!
Slow through the air outside off, Mathews comes forward and defends it to the off side.
Fullish ball on off, driven firmly towards Rabada who half-stops it on his followthrough.
Slips this one down the leg side and it's swinging further down, easy leave for Chandimal.
Hurls this one wider outside off, Chandimal doesn't fiddle with that one.
Rabada has his tail up here! Back of a length outside off and gets this one to lift exceedingly from the pitch. Dinesh drops his wrists and leaves it alone.
Bowls it just a back of a length outside off, Chandimal points his bat skywards and allows it through.
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, Chandimal comes forward and defends it to the covers.

Tossed up around leg, Chandimal clears his front leg and drives it to long on for a single. Philander present there hurls a throw on the non-striker's end . There's no backing up and the ball goes towards the other side. Abbott does the covering up. Till then, batsmen run through for a couple on the overthrow. Three runs added to the total!
Tossed up outside off, defended to covers.
Fuller on the stumps, driven to long on for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Mathews gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over widish mid off for a boundary. Good shot!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Four Leg byes! Down the leg side, DC looks to clip it but misses and the ball goes off the pads, beating de Kock towards the fence behind. Leg byes signalled!
Full and angling in, Mathews gets his bat down in time and defends it to mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mathews gets on his toes and blocks it.
Angling down leg, worked down the leg side for a single.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
Length delivery, shaping away a touch, Mathews looks to steer it but goes off the outside edge towards point for a single.
Sliding down leg, DC looks to flick but misses and is rapped up on the pads.
Fuller on off, driven through mid on. Faf at silly mid on misfields and allows the batsmen to take a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on the stumps, driven to silly mid on. Faf is the man present there. He stops the ball and hurls a throw towards his keeper in  aggression.

Flatter one outside off, AM looks to sweep it but misses and gets hit on the pad. The fielding side appeals but umpire Dar says not out. It's a good decision as the Hawk Eye shows that the impact was outside off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full outside off, DC looks to drive it but is playing the wrong line and the ball whistles past the outside edge of the bat.
Banged in short, Chandimal lest it go to the keeper.

OUT! RABADA STRIKES ONCE AGAIN! Full and angling in, de Silva looks to play across the line but is late into the shot and is rapped up on the pads on the full. Rabada and co. appeal and umpire Tucker raises his finger in agreement. De Silva goes towards his skipper to discuss whether or not to take the review and his skipper says not to take it. In the end, it proves to be a poor decision as the Hawk Eye shows that the ball was going down leg and missing leg stump completely. Dhananjaya's decent knock comes to an end.
Length delivery angling in, defended off the back foot.
Outside off, left alone!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Landed around off, spinning away, Mathews looks to defend with a straight bat but gets squared up and goes off the outside edge towards backward point.
Floated around off, Mathews prods forward in defence.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On middle and leg, flicked on the leg side.
Fuller on off, defended off the front foot.
Length delivery angling in, defended with soft hands near short leg for a quick single.
Two Byes! Banged in short, Mathews ducks under it. De Kock behind the stumps also fails to grab it. However, he half stops it, slowing down the ball. The batsmen run through for two byes!
Full and angling in, flicked on the leg side.
BEATEN! Great delivery first up! Full outside off, Mathews leans into the shot, looking to play it with a straight bat but the ball moves away a touch and beats the outside edge of the skipper's bat.
The skipper, ANGELO MATHEWS walks in, replacing Silva.

OUT! RABADA WITH THE BREAKTHROUGH! Back of a length delivery, angling into the body, Kaushal Silva looks to tuck it with the angle down the leg side but the ball rises onto him and balloons off the gloves in the air. Cook at short leg gets under the ball and takes it cleanly. Silva's resistance comes to an end! That's the end of the 41-run partnership. SA NEED 7 WICKETS MORE TO WIN!
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! De Silva dances down and smashes it straight down the ground for a boundary. Good use of the feet there!
The batsman dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Tossed up on the stumps, driven to mid off.
Quicker through the air, de Silva dances down and pads it away. Maharaj starts appealing but is turned down by the umpire.
Outside off, blocked on the off side.
Tossed up on middle and off, defended off the front foot.
Drinks break! Kaushal Silva has a change of grip for his bat in the break.
Banged in short, Silva lets it sail through.

Fullish outside off, KS looks to steer it but the ball bounce more than he expects, goes off the higher part of the bat and the bottom hand comes out while playing the shot. The ball goes uppishly and falls just short of Bavuma at point making it difficult to stop. The ball then runs behind. Duminy from gully chases it and keeps it down to two.
Pitched outside off, Kaushal Silva opts to leave it.
Angling down leg, Silva leaves it.
Outside off, left alone.
Full outside off, Kaushal looks to drive it but ends up digging it out off the inner half of the bat towards short leg.
KAGISO RABADA is back into the attack.
Slower through the air on middle and leg, KS dances down and places it through widish mid on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Silva charges down and drives it but once again finds the same fielder at covers.
Full outside off, driven to covers.
Tossed up around off, driven to long on for a single.
Flatter one on the stumps, defended from within the crease.
Very full on off, dug out nicely.
Angling into stumps, defended solidly straight down the ground.
Fuller around off, KS shuffles a touch and drives it to mid on.
On a good length outside off, angling in, Kaushal is sure of his off pole and does a brave leave.
On off, angling in, Silva blocks it off the front foot to covers.
Pitched outside off, Kaushal lets it through to the keeper.
Fuller and angled in onto the stumps, dug out nicely by KS.
Tossed up nicely outside off, Dhananjaya dead-bats it near the surface.
Outside off, spinning in, defended from within the crease.
De Silva stays solid in his defence to the outside off delivery.
Floated on middle and off, de Silva prods forward in defence.
Tossed up on the stumps, driven to mid off.
On leg, defended by clearing the front leg.
Back of a length outside off, shapes away, Kaushal draws out of the shot once again at the very last moment.
Full on off, the batsman has driven it straight down the ground. They pick up a single.

On a length outside off, Silva hangs his bat and the ball goes off the outer half of the bat into the ground and to Duminy at gully. He dives to his right but only manages to half-stop it, allowing the batsmen to run through for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Silva prods forward and shoulders his arms.
Outside off, left alone.

Length delivery outside off, Kaushal first looks to play at it but then decides to leave it at the last moment. It's too late for the leave and the ball goes off the inside edge through his legs. He is lucky not to have dragged it back to his own stumps!
Sliding into the pads, defended near the surface.
FOUR! Short delivery outside off, de Silva camps back and cuts it through cover-point for a boundary.
Darted in on middle and leg, defended from within the crease.
SIX! WHAT A SHOT! Tossed up on middle, Dhananjaya gets to the pitch of the ball and launches it straight down the ground for a huge maximum.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up around off, driven through covers for a single.
Outside off, de Silva with another leave to end the over.
Another close leave outside off but this time de Silva is more sure about it.
That was a very risky leave! Pitched on a good length outside off, nips back in, DdS covers his stumps and shoulders his arms. He too gets surprised by that inward movement off the seam.
Pitched on a length outside off, Dhananjaya stays composed in his defence.
Length delivery angling in, defended with the angle on the leg side.
On a length outside off, shaping away, an easy leave for the batsman.
Angling down leg, Silva looks to clip it but misses. Kaushal should be more careful and not go after such wide deliveries.
Back of a length outside off, bounces a touch extra. Kaushal looks to punch it on the up but once again is beaten by the extra bounce.
Pitched outside off, left alone.
Angling into the pads, clipped through the leg side for a couple.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Full outside off, de Silva stays in his crease and elegantly pushes through covers. Maharaj chases it and saves a run for his team.
On the stumps, defended with a straight bat.
Fuller on the stumps, defended watchfully by Kaushal.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length delivery outside off, Kaushal leans ahead and defends.
FOUR! Full outside off, driven beautifully through mid off for a boundary. That was a well-balanced shot!
KYLE ABBOTT replaces Philander.
Fuller on the stumps, driven to mid on.
FOUR BYES! Banged in short, takes off after pitching, Dhananjaya ducks under it and lets it sail through. The ball even beats de Kock behind the stumps and races away to the fence behind.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot.
Great stuff from Rabada! Back of a length delivery, angling in, nips back in sharply, beats de Silva and hits him on the thigh pad.
Back of a length delivery outside off, DdS looks to punch it on the up but the ball rises a touch extra and beats de Silva on his punch.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
BEATEN AGAIN! On a length outside off, moving away, KS once again looks to defend it with a straight bat, this time the gap between the bat and the ball is even lesser than the previous one.
Length delivery outside off, Silva looks to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten as the ball shapes away!
Length delivery outside off, Kaushal draws out of the shot at the last moment. That was really close!
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Full outside off, pushed to covers for a brace.
Length delivery outside off, KS prods forward in defence but edges it into the ground towards gully. Playing with soft hands saved him there!
Leg bye! Full and angling in once again, Silva looks to flick but misses and the ball goes off the pads past short leg and the batsmen run through for a leg bye.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Down the leg side, Kaushal looks to clip it but misses and the ball goes in the gloves of keeper behind. As the ball goes past him there's some sound which makes SA appeal in unison but Faf isn't appealing and rightly so as seen in the replay that it went off the pad.
Angling into the stumps, flicked through mid-wicket for three runs.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Full and angling in, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery outside off, de Silva looks to defend but the ball goes off the outer half of the bat to gully.
Banged in short, de Silva ducks under it.

Full outside off, driven straight back. Philander grabs the ball and hurls a throw immediately at the striker's end. Silva at the non-striker's end goes down on the ground as soon as de Silva hits it.
DHANANJAYA DE SILVA is in at No.4.

OUT! Philander has struck once again! Full outside off, drawing Mendis into a drive. The youngster looks to drive it on the up but pays the price for it as the ball moves away, catches the outside edge and flies straight to Elgar at third slip. Lack of experience from Mendis! SA NEED 8 WICKETS MORE TO WIN!
Full outside off, shaping away, driven straight back for three runs.

Full and angling in, Silva looks to defend it with the angle but gets squared up as the ball moves away a touch. The leading edge takes the ball through the gap between the slip cordon and gully. Duminy gives it a chase and keeps it down to two.
VERNON PHILANDER to continue from the other end.
Kusal Mendis seems to be in some discomfort and the physio has come out in the middle to help him with some stretching exercises.
Fuller and angling in on the stumps, Mendis defends it solidly on the leg side.
Angling down leg once more, Kusal looks to flick it but once again misses it.
Angling down leg, KM looks to tuck it but misses.
Back of a length delivery outside off, tapped towards backward point.
Full and angling in, Mendis shuffles a touch and flicks it uppishly but the ball goes one bounce in the hands of mid-wicket fielder.
Full outside off, Silva leans into the shot and drives it through covers for three runs.
The players are back in the middle for the final session of day 3. Kusal Mendis and Kaushal Silva will continue to bat. KAGISO RABADA to start the proceedings with the ball.
... DAY 3, SESSION 3 ...

After setting such a huge total, they came up with the goods with the ball and got rid of the opening partnership which lasted the longest in the first innings. Now, SA need only 9 wickets more to win with 7 session still remaining. The Lankans will now have to bat in the tricky twilight time, making it all the more difficult. We will be back in a short while for the last session of day 3.

The hosts after making the visitors bat for the half an hour before tea sent Karunaratne packing and are now well and truly ahead in the match. They came after lunch all guns blazing, fired away some quick runs and declared their innings, setting a target of 507 for the Islanders.
Pounds the deck hard and keeps it on the shorter side, on off, cramping the batsman for room. But Mendis does well to hang back, rise and keep it down on the track. That will be TEA ON DAY 3!
Excellent shape, lovely from Vernon Philander. And credit to Mendis as well for staying disciplined. Back of a length just around off, going away, the 21-year old leaves it alone.
Philander is having some problem with the ball and has asked the umpire to clean it a bit with his instruments.

FOUR! Top shot. He drives this on the up but it's hit nicely in the gap. Mendis needs to be a little careful though, these are dangerous shots to play, especially just before the break. Full and swinging away wide outside off, reaches out to this and hits it over cover-point for a boundary.
Back of a length, straightening up after pitching, Kusal Mendis leaves it alone.

Good shape on that and it's decently kept out by Kusal Mendis. He plays this with a slightly closed face as the ball twists in his hands when he is just about to play the shot. Hit back down the track for no run.
Full ball from Vernon Philander, it's blocked in front of short cover by Mendis.
Fuller ball aiming the base of off stump, met with a straight blade to end the over.
Angles this one in on off, KS keeps bat and pad close together to present a tight defensive shot.
Abbott is swinging this away from the batsman, darts this just outside off as Silva makes a late leave. Needs to be careful here, he could just as easily drag this back on.
Uppish from Kaushal Silva but it's in the gap. Closes his body up a bit and flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Good length delivery moving away outside off, Silva chooses not to do anything about it.
Sprays this down the leg side, on a fuller length, Silva with an attempted flick which misses.
KUSAL MENDIS walks in at no. 3!

OUT! HE'S GOT 'EM! Set himself nicely by changing the angle and varying the lengths too. Teed him up with a couple of short ones, then went full. Almost got him on the previous delivery as well. Have to admire the strategy. Philander fires in a fuller inswinging delivery and bowls it around off, Dimuth Karunaratne goes for the expansive drive but gets an inside edge which shatters the leg stump and sends it flying out of its roots. An early breakthrough for Philander and South Africa will be loving this.
Oooohhhhh.... That was close. That almost seeped through. Fires this up there as it's coming back in, DK gets an inside edge onto his pads as the ball rolls towards the slip cordon. Almost got him.
Good carry through to de Kock. It's angled across as DK makes an easy leave. Withdraws his bat and watches it go past him.
Slips this down the leg side, Dimuth looks to flick it away fine but cannot do so.
A bit straighter this time and it's coming back in once more, Karunaratne flicks this away but it's straight to the mid-wicket fielder.

Philander switches the angle for Karunaratne and comes from over the wicket, pitches this on a length just outside off. The ball comes back in but still goes past the off stump comfortably. Good leave by the southpaw.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Stays right behind the line of this delivery and blocks it solidly.

That's the perfect length to bowl at right now. Full and swinging away outside off, Silva is late in leaving that and ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads before the ball rolls behind towards Quinton de Kock.

Similar line and length from Kyle Abbott, Kaushal Silva defends this off the outer part of the bat towards gully where the diving fielder makes a good stop and parries it to Bavuma at backward point. He releases the ball in a flash and keeps the batsmen from taking a run.
Good length ball outside off once more, it's left alone.
Superb line from Kyle, bowls this on a length in the corridor of uncertainty, takes the outside edge and falls short of the gully fielder.
Back of a length delivery which is defended out off the back foot. That will be the end of the over.
Karunaratne looking rather uncomfortable out there, a contrast to his first innings. It's coming back in heavily on a length, raps him in the box.
On the fuller side once more, it's driven towards mid off for one run.
Fuller ball from Philander, it's defended off the front foot and into the track.
Angling in from around off, on a fullish length, it goes off the inside edge and towards square leg as the batsmen take a single.
Muted shout for an lbw. Turned down rightly. Philander looking for the leg before angles this in sharply on a fuller length, catches Dimuth on the pads but not before taking the inside edge.
Rock solid from Kaushal Silva. He stays right behind the line of this length ball on off and keeps it out solidly with a straight blade.
Back of a length outside off, moving in the air after going past the batsman, it's left alone.

Stifled shout for an lbw but it was always going down leg.  Coming in on middle and leg, raps Silva on the pads as he misses his attempted flick. The umpire correctly doesn't respond to the leg before appeal.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Length delivery outside off, Kaushal Silva makes a watchful leave.
FOUR! Too full and too straight from Abbott and it's been put away. Kaushal Silva closes his body up and with a slightly closed face, flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

That's cut him in two! Beautiful from Vernon Philander. Angles it in sharply and beats Dimuth Karunaratne completely. Goes right through bat and pad as de Kock shuffles across to his right to take it.
On a good length and outside off, Karunaratne raises his bat upwards and lets it be. There's some late movement as the ball goes away from the batsman after passing him.
Tad fullish in the off stump channel, let through for de Kock to collect in his gloves.
FOUR! Nicely done. He works this away through backward square leg with the angle and places it in the gap beautifully. Goes away to the fence and that will be a boundary.
Fires this on a fullish length and angles it down leg, Karunaratne goes for the flick shot but cannot put bat on ball.
Doesn't get it. He comes from around the wicket and hurls this on a length outside off, it's not played at by Dimuth.
VERNON PHILANDER to bowl from the other end. He's on a hat-trick here. Remember, he took 2 wickets off the final two balls in the previous innings.
Length delivery outside off, left alone to end the over.
Pitches this fractionally ahead of a length, on off, Kaushal Silva brings down a straight blade and keeps it out.
Sprays this down the leg side, Silva looks to flick it down fine but fails to do so.
Waits for the ball to come back in to him this time, it's worked away on the on side for an easy single.

That one came back in sharply, didn't it? Karunaratne would have had his heart in his mouth surely. The look on Abbott's face says it all. He gets this one to jag back in sharply as Dimuth shoulders his arms to it. Doesn't expect the ball to come back in so sharply. It just whiskers past the off stump.
Abbott gets things going as he starts off from around the wicket, bowls a widish fuller length ball outside off, Karunaratne doesn't fiddle with it.
